name: ts-lj38-dimer
label: develop-template
ini:
[Main]
job = saddle_search
finite_difference = 0.001
random_seed = 1
parallel = false

[Potential]
potential = ext_pot
ext_pot_path = /tmp/optbench-extpot-_3gacvtk/extpot-bridge

[Optimizer]
opt_method = lbfgs
convergence_metric = norm
converged_force = 0.001
max_move = 0.1
max_iterations = 3000

[Dimer]
opt_method = cg
improved = true
finite_angle = 0.005
converged_angle = 0.1
rotations_max = 20
rotations_min = 1

[LBFGS]
lbfgs_memory = 20
lbfgs_inverse_curvature = 0.01
lbfgs_max_inverse_curvature = 0.0
lbfgs_auto_scale = true
lbfgs_angle_reset = true
lbfgs_distance_reset = true
lbfgs_curvature = reset
lbfgs_project_rigid = false
lbfgs_secant = standard
lbfgs_precon = none
lbfgs_step = lbfgs
lbfgs_h0 = sy_yy
lbfgs_accept = energy
lbfgs_extra_updates = 0
lbfgs_cautious_eps = 1e-06
lbfgs_cautious_alpha = 0.01
lbfgs_precon_A = 3.0
lbfgs_precon_mu = 1.0
lbfgs_precon_rcut = 0.0

[Saddle Search]
min_mode_method = dimer
client_displace_type = load
converged_force = 0.001
max_iterations = 3000
displace_magnitude = 0.1
